Class Matrix4

java.lang.Object
net.murat.math.Matrix4
public class Matrix4 extends Object
Represents a 4x4 matrix for 3D transformations.

Design goal: zero garbage in hot paths (ray tracing inner loops). Every instance method that can mutate a pre-allocated target and avoid heap allocation now does so, including a few call sites that previously allocated hidden temporaries on every invocation (inverse(Matrix4), transformRay(Ray), multiply(Matrix4)).

Methods that are documented as ALLOCATES are kept only because their signature has no target parameter to write into (mostly the static factory methods and the no-arg legacy overloads of inverse() and inverseTransposeForNormal()). These are intended for one-time scene setup / parsing, not per-pixel or per-ray hot paths. Prefer the target-parameter overload wherever one is available.

    • transformRay

      public Ray transformRay(Ray ray)
      Transforms a ray in place. Previously allocated a fresh Point3 and Vector3 on every call; now reuses per-instance scratch fields (scratchRayOrigin / scratchRayDirection) instead. No allocation.

      Not reentrant/thread-safe on the same Matrix4 instance, consistent with the rest of this class's scratch-field usage.

    • multiply

      public Matrix4 multiply(Matrix4 other, Matrix4 target)
      Multiplies this matrix by other and stores the result in target (does not mutate this or other). No heap allocation - uses 16 local stack variables instead of a temporary array.

    • multiply

      public Matrix4 multiply(Matrix4 other)
      Multiplies this matrix by other in place (mutates this). Previously allocated a temporary double[16]; now computes into 16 local stack variables before writing back. No heap allocation.

    • inverse

      public boolean inverse(Matrix4 target)
      Computes the inverse (mutates target). No allocation - the translation/inverse-translation vectors used internally are per-instance scratch fields (scratchTranslation / scratchInvTranslation) rather than freshly allocated Vector3 instances.
      Returns:
      true if invertible, false otherwise

    • inverse

      public Matrix4 inverse()
      Computes inverse (allocates a new Matrix4).

      ALLOCATES - signature has no target parameter, so one Matrix4 allocation is unavoidable here. Use inverse(Matrix4) in any hot path.

    • add

      public static Matrix4 add(Matrix4 trsA, Matrix4 trsB)
      Combines two TRS matrices by summing their translation/rotation/scale components and rebuilding a composite matrix.

      ALLOCATES several intermediate Matrix4 instances (translation, three rotation matrices, combined rotation, scale, and the final product). This is a scene-setup / animation-blending helper, not intended for per-pixel or per-ray hot paths.
